critiques.question: Does the autonomous wound change the later stroke geometry, or only place a pale scar on top?
Does the timed return make the brush autonomous without disguising v001's visitor-driven history?
Does the first frame read as a tableau before the explanation, and does reduced motion preserve the material consequence?

critiques.observed: The field reads as a restrained autonomous tableau and the wound is visible, but the relationship between wound and later stroke detour is not perceptually singular enough to carry the work without the explanatory copy.
critiques.next_test: Re-compose the wound and the first affected later stroke so the material consequence is visible on the canvas before requesting a fresh critique.

critiques.observed: In the reduced compositions, dark contour strokes visibly kink into localized V- and S-shaped detours adjacent to the pale/orange wound marks; the normal row stays comparatively smooth. The sparse layered field reads as an autonomous tableau without relying on labels.
critiques.next_test: Run the release defender against the deployed public URL before promoting the candidate to a work.

critiques.observed: The work is visually coherent and the isolated preview is convincing, but the causal wound-to-stroke change is not perceptually unambiguous enough to promote. On the normal route, a later stage showed altered overall curvature without an unmistakable local detour around an inherited wound; the pale marks can still read as overlays. The normal first viewport is text-led, while the isolated preview puts the artwork first. Brush v001 remains honestly differentiated as a held visitor interaction. The v002 canvas has an accessible image role and no visible responsive defect at the inspected size, although console inspection returned blank exception entries after navigation.
blocking_concerns: The inherited wound does not yet read as the unmistakable local cause of a later stroke detour.
The normal route presents title and premise before and beside the tableau, weakening first-encounter priority.
Blank console exception entries remain an unresolved technical warning despite the absence of a readable message.
critiques.next_test: Keep promotion held and revise the normal composition so the canvas leads, while making one or two later strokes visibly take unmistakable local detours around retained wounds; then repeat the visual review on both exact routes and recheck the console.
